top_signals.title: Caterpillar Raises Sales Outlook on Data Center Boom
top_signals.summary: Caterpillar Inc. crushed Wall Street’s second-quarter expectations as the company reported stronger sales across its businesses, posted a record equipment backlog and increased its forecast for 2026 sales. Matthew Griffin reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: AI Trade Has Entered ‘Kindness of Strangers’ Phase, Says One CIO
top_signals.summary: If investors are still harboring major worries about the disappearing cash flows at some Big Tech companies, you’d never know it by looking at the US stock market that’s once again trading near record highs.
